require "json"
require "http/server"
require "option_parser"
require "log"
require "digest/md5"
require "file_utils"
require "yaml"

module JAIDE
  class DataWorker
    property log : Log
    property config : Hash(String, YAML::Any)
    property queue : Channel(Tuple(String, String))
    property metrics : Hash(String, Float64)
    property metrics_mutex : Mutex
    property trajectory : Array(Array(Float64))
    property xs : Array(Float64)
    property stop_channel : Channel(Nil)?

    def initialize(config_path : String)
      @log = Log.for(self.class.name)
      @config = YAML.parse(File.read(config_path)).as_h
      @queue = Channel(Tuple(String, String)).new(@config["queue_size"]?.try(&.as_i) || 1000)
      @metrics = {"processed" => 0.0, "errors" => 0.0, "avg_time" => 0.0}
      @metrics_mutex = Mutex.new
      @trajectory = compute_trajectory
      @xs = @trajectory.map { |pt| pt[0] }.sort
      @stop_channel = nil
    end

    def compute_trajectory : Array(Array(Float64))
      lorenz_config = @config["lorenz"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      sigma = lorenz_config["sigma"]?.try(&.as_f) || 10.0
      rho = lorenz_config["rho"]?.try(&.as_f) || 28.0
      beta = lorenz_config["beta"]?.try(&.as_f) || (8.0 / 3.0)
      dt = lorenz_config["dt"]?.try(&.as_f) || 0.01
      steps = lorenz_config["steps"]?.try(&.as_i) || 100
      x = lorenz_config["x0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 0.1
      y = lorenz_config["y0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 1.0
      z = lorenz_config["z0"]?.try(&.as_f) || 1.05
      traj = [] of Array(Float64)
      steps.times do
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dt * dx
        y += dt * dy
        z += dt * dz
        traj << [x, y, z]
      end
      traj
    end

    def start
      log.info { "DataWorker starting with #{@config["num_threads"]?.try(&.as_i) || 4} threads" }
      spawn_http_server
      spawn_processor
      spawn_metrics_reporter
      @stop_channel = Channel(Nil).new
      @stop_channel.receive
    end

    def spawn_http_server
      server = HTTP::Server.new do |context|
        begin
          if context.request.method == "POST" && context.request.path == "/ingest"
            body = context.request.body.try(&.gets_to_end) || ""
            json_data = JSON.parse(body)
            data_hash = json_data.as_h
            id = data_hash["id"]?.try(&.as_s)
            content = data_hash["content"]?.try(&.as_s)
            if id.nil? || content.nil?
              raise ArgumentError.new("invalid payload")
            end
            @queue.send({id.not_nil!, content.not_nil!})
            context.response.status_code = 200
            context.response.content_type = "application/json"
            context.response.print({status: "ingested"}.to_json)
          else
            context.response.status_code = 404
            context.response.content_type = "application/json"
            context.response.print({error: "not found"}.to_json)
          end
        rescue ex
          context.response.status_code = 400
          context.response.content_type = "application/json"
          context.response.print({error: ex.message}.to_json)
        end
      end
      address = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h)["host"]?.try(&.as_s) || "127.0.0.1"
      port = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h)["port"]?.try(&.as_i) || 8080
      server.bind_tcp address, port
      spawn do
        begin
          server.listen
        rescue ex
          log.error { "HTTP server error: #{ex}" }
        end
      end
    end

    def spawn_processor
      threads = @config["num_threads"]?.try(&.as_i) || 4
      threads.times do
        spawn do
          loop do
            begin
              id, content = @queue.receive
              start_time = Time.monotonic
              success = false
              begin
                process_data(id, content)
                success = true
              rescue ex
                log.error { "Error processing #{id}: #{ex}" }
              ensure
                duration = Time.monotonic - start_time
                duration_ms = duration.total_milliseconds.to_f
                @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
                  prev_count = @metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"]
                  if success
                    @metrics["processed"] += 1.0
                  else
                    @metrics["errors"] += 1.0
                  end
                  new_count = prev_count + 1.0
                  @metrics["avg_time"] = new_count > 0.0 ? ((@metrics["avg_time"] * prev_count) + duration_ms) / new_count : 0.0
                end
              end
            rescue ex
              log.error { "Processor thread error: #{ex}" }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def process_data(id : String, content : String) : String
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      embeds = embed_lorenz(tokens)
      normalized = normalize(embeds)
      hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(normalized.to_s)
      server_config = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      out_dir = server_config["output_dir"]?.try(&.as_s) || "./output"
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(out_dir)
      begin
        File.write("#{out_dir}/#{id}.json", {hash: hash, tokens: tokens, embeds: embeds}.to_json)
      rescue ex
        log.error { "File write error for #{id}: #{ex}" }
        raise ex
      end
      hash
    end

    def tokenize(content : String) : Array(Int32)
      content.chars.map { |c| c.ord % 75 }.to_a
    end

    def embed_lorenz(tokens : Array(Int32)) : Array(Float64)
      embeds = [] of Float64
      dim = @config["embedding_dimension"]?.try(&.as_i) || 18432
      tokens.each_with_index do |tid, t|
        norm_tid = tid.to_f / 75.0
        traj_idx = t % @trajectory.size
        traj_pt = @trajectory[traj_idx]
        basis = b_spline_basis(norm_tid, @xs, 3)
        spline_wt = traj_pt[2] * basis.sum
        (1..dim).each do |d|
          phase = 2.0 * Math::PI * d.to_f / dim.to_f
          mod_x = traj_pt[0] * Math.cos(phase) + traj_pt[1] * Math.sin(phase)
          embeds << norm_tid * mod_x * spline_wt
        end
      end
      embeds
    end

    def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int32) : Array(Float64)
      if knots.size < degree + 1
        raise ArgumentError.new("Not enough knots for given degree")
      end
      n_knots = knots.size
      if degree == 0
        basis = Array(Float64).new(n_knots - 1, 0.0)
        (0...(n_knots - 1)).each do |i|
          if (knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]) || (i == n_knots - 2 && x == knots.last)
            basis[i] = 1.0
          end
        end
        return basis
      end
      basis_len = n_knots - degree - 1
      basis = Array(Float64).new(basis_len, 0.0)
      sub = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
      (0...basis.size).each do |i|
        left_denom = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
        right_denom = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
        left_num = left_denom != 0.0 ? (x - knots[i]) / left_denom : 0.0
        right_num = right_denom != 0.0 ? (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / right_denom : 0.0
        left_val = i < sub.size ? sub[i] : 0.0
        right_val = (i + 1) < sub.size ? sub[i + 1] : 0.0
        basis[i] = left_num * left_val + right_num * right_val
      end
      basis
    end

    def normalize(embeds : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
      if embeds.empty?
        return [] of Float64
      end
      mean = embeds.sum / embeds.size.to_f
      variance = embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) ** 2 }.sum / embeds.size.to_f
      var = Math.sqrt(variance)
      if var > 0.0
        embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) / var }
      else
        Array(Float64).new(embeds.size, 0.0)
      end
    end

    def spawn_metrics_reporter
      spawn do
        loop do
          begin
            sleep 10
            snapshot = {} of String => Float64
            @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
              snapshot["processed"] = @metrics["processed"]
              snapshot["errors"] = @metrics["errors"]
              snapshot["avg_time"] = @metrics["avg_time"]
            end
            log.info { "Metrics: processed=#{snapshot["processed"]}, errors=#{snapshot["errors"]}, avg_time=#{snapshot["avg_time"]}ms" }
          rescue ex
            log.error { "Metrics reporter error: #{ex}" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

ran = false
OptionParser.parse do |parser|
  parser.on("-c PATH", "--config PATH", "Config file") do |path|
    JAIDE::DataWorker.new(path).start
    ran = true
  end
end
unless ran
  STDERR.puts "Usage: #{PROGRAM_NAME} -c PATH"
  exit 1
end

                log.error { "Error processing #{id}: #{ex}" }
              ensure
                duration = Time.monotonic - start_time
                duration_ms = duration.total_milliseconds
                @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
                  prev_count = @metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"]
                  if success
                    @metrics["processed"] += 1.0
                  else
                    @metrics["errors"] += 1.0
                  end
                  new_count = prev_count + 1.0
                  @metrics["avg_time"] = new_count > 0.0 ? ((@metrics["avg_time"] * prev_count) + duration_ms) / new_count : 0.0
                end
              end
            rescue ex
              log.error { "Processor thread error: #{ex}" }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def process_data(id : String, content : String) : String
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      embeds = embed_lorenz(tokens)
      normalized = normalize(embeds)
      io = IO::Memory.new(normalized.size * 8)
      normalized.each do |f|
        io.write_bytes(f, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
      end
      hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(io.to_slice)
      server_config = @config["server"]?.try(&.as_h) || {} of String => YAML::Any
      out_dir = server_config["output_dir"]?.try(&.as_s) || "./output"
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(out_dir)
      begin
        File.open("#{out_dir}/#{id}.json", "w") do |f|
          JSON.build(f) do |json|
            json.object do
              json.field "hash", hash
              json.field "tokens" do
                json.array do
                  tokens.each { |t| json.number t }
                end
              end
              json.field "embeds" do
                json.array do
                  normalized.each { |e| json.number e }
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      rescue ex
        log.error { "File write error for #{id}: #{ex}" }
        raise ex
      end
      hash
    end

    def tokenize(content : String) : Array(Int32)
      content.chars.map { |c| c.ord % 75 }.to_a
    end

    def embed_lorenz(tokens : Array(Int32)) : Array(Float64)
      dim_conf = @config["embedding_dimension"]?.try(&.as_i) || 18432
      dim = dim_conf.to_i32
      cos_vals = Array(Float64).new(dim) { |i| Math.cos(2.0 * Math::PI * (i + 1).to_f / dim.to_f) }
      sin_vals = Array(Float64).new(dim) { |i| Math.sin(2.0 * Math::PI * (i + 1).to_f / dim.to_f) }
      result = Array(Float64).new(tokens.size * dim, 0.0)
      idx = 0
      tokens.each_with_index do |tid, t|
        norm_tid = tid.to_f / 75.0
        traj_pt = @trajectory[t % @trajectory.size]
        basis = b_spline_basis(norm_tid, @xs, 3)
        spline_wt = traj_pt[2] * basis.sum
        tx = traj_pt[0]
        ty = traj_pt[1]
        k = 0
        while k < dim
          mod_x = tx * cos_vals[k] + ty * sin_vals[k]
          result[idx] = norm_tid * mod_x * spline_wt
          idx += 1
          k += 1
        end
      end
      result
    end

    def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int32) : Array(Float64)
      if knots.size < degree + 1
        raise ArgumentError.new("Not enough knots for given degree")
      end
      n_knots = knots.size
      if degree == 0
        basis = Array(Float64).new(n_knots - 1, 0.0)
        (0...(n_knots - 1)).each do |i|
          if (knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]) || (i == n_knots - 2 && x == knots.last)
            basis[i] = 1.0
          end
        end
        return basis
      end
      basis_len = n_knots - degree - 1
      basis = Array(Float64).new(basis_len, 0.0)
      sub = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
      (0...basis.size).each do |i|
        left_denom = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
        right_denom = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
        left_num = left_denom != 0.0 ? (x - knots[i]) / left_denom : 0.0
        right_num = right_denom != 0.0 ? (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / right_denom : 0.0
        left_val = i < sub.size ? sub[i] : 0.0
        right_val = (i + 1) < sub.size ? sub[i + 1] : 0.0
        basis[i] = left_num * left_val + right_num * right_val
      end
      basis
    end

    def normalize(embeds : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
      return [] of Float64 if embeds.empty?
      mean = 0.0
      m2 = 0.0
      count = 0.0
      embeds.each do |e|
        count += 1.0
        delta = e - mean
        mean += delta / count
        m2 += delta * (e - mean)
      end
      variance = m2 / count
      std = Math.sqrt(variance)
      if std > 0.0
        embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) / std }
      else
        Array(Float64).new(embeds.size, 0.0)
      end
    end

    def spawn_metrics_reporter
      spawn do
        loop do
          begin
            sleep 10
            snapshot = {} of String => Float64
            @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
              snapshot["processed"] = @metrics["processed"]
              snapshot["errors"] = @metrics["errors"]
              snapshot["avg_time"] = @metrics["avg_time"]
            end
            log.info { "Metrics: processed=#{snapshot["processed"]}, errors=#{snapshot["errors"]}, avg_time=#{snapshot["avg_time"]}ms" }
          rescue ex
            log.error { "Metrics reporter error: #{ex}" }
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

    JAIDE::DataWorker.new(path).start

  end
